[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|subset=One Year Earlier|cardname=Grand Moff Tarkin|link=https://www.beckett.com/non-sports/2013/star-wars-illustrated-a-new-hope-one-year-earlier/oy11-grand-moff-tarkin-9550174}}</ref> [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] owned an '''apartment''' high on the residential level of the [[Prime Senate Spire]] on<ref name="Rogue Planet" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The apartment was small but luxurious and sat two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] higher than most of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue Planet]]''&mdash;which includes the meeting in the apartment&mdash;to [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref> Tarkin hosted a meeting with<ref name="Rogue Planet" /> [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems']] [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]]<ref name="New Essential">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Ke Daiv]] in his apartment.<ref name="Rogue Planet" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Topps Date">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|subset=One Year Earlier|cardname=Grand Moff Tarkin|link=https://www.beckett.com/non-sports/2013/star-wars-illustrated-a-new-hope-one-year-earlier/oy11-grand-moff-tarkin-9550174}} states that all cards in the "One Year Earlier" set take place a [[Standard year|year]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which correspond to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Grand Moff and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Thalassa Tarkin|Thalassa]] were present in the apartment when he informed her of his new assignment aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]<ref name="Topps" /> [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The apartment first appeared in ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', a [[2005]] novel by [[Greg Bear]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" /> It was first pictured on the trading card "Grand Moff Tarkin," published as part of the trading card subset "One Year Earlier" from the ''[[2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope]]'' series<ref name="Topps" /> on [[November 6]], [[2013]].<ref name="SWI145">[[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]] {{C|Advertisement}}</ref>
